arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'hold',h.booking_id,'checkin',c.booking_id) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN checkins c USING(booking_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges
UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status != 'delivered'
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('id',event_id,'request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache
UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'version',version,'capacity',capacity) FROM flights

SELECT 'config' AS kind, json_object('service',service,'value',value) AS data FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('id',e.event_id,'request',e.request_id,'step',e.step,'booking',b.booking_id,'status',b.status) FROM customer_events e LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(request_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' ORDER BY kind, data
